name: Corn then soybean
description: Two-year corn and soybean with the field left bare over winter.

name: Corn and soybean with winter cover crops
description: Same cash crops as corn-soybean but the field stays covered in winter.

name: Corn then wheat and double-crop soybean
description: Three harvests in two years. Wheat covers the first winter.

name: Sorghum then wheat and double-crop soybean
description: Swaps corn for drought-tolerant sorghum and keeps a winter crop every year.

name: Alfalfa hay then corn and soybean
description: Three years of alfalfa hay then two years of grain.

name: Summer forage with clover and corn
description: Summer forage grass for grazing or hay then corn with a rye cover.

name: Soybean and radish then corn and rye
description: Adds a deep-rooted radish cover after soybean and rye after corn.

name: Alfalfa hay then three years of corn
description: Matches the CropScape record for the Fallon field: four years of alfalfa then three of corn with bare winters.

name: Alfalfa hay then corn and wheat
description: Long alfalfa stand then corn and winter wheat with summer forage after the wheat.

name: Alfalfa hay then sorghum and corn
description: Swaps one corn year for sorghum which needs less water and adds a rye cover.

name: Shorter alfalfa stand with summer forage
description: Two years of alfalfa then summer forage and corn with rye over both winters.

name: Corn and sorghum with winter wheat
description: Grain only with no hay equipment needed. Wheat and rye cover the winters.
